claims.claim: There is still a corpus to rebuild from
claims.detail: 1,098 archived catalogue rows carry a YouTube id; 815 of 1,084 checked (75%) are still playable through oEmbed. 269 links have rotted since 2008-2021. 0 videos still serve an HD thumbnail.

claims.claim: A model can replace the taxonomy the archive lost
claims.detail: On 822 videos where the 2008 editors had a tag, the model lands in the same broad subject 61% of the time. Most disagreements are the editors' own drift: education → Language and Literature (23), education → Health and Psychology (19), education → Geography and Society (17).
Across 822 judged videos: 41% score below 0.40, 48% sit in the ambiguous 0.40-0.60 band, 12% clear 0.60. Standard deviation 0.14. The judgment is doing work rather than returning a constant.

claims.claim: A model separates classroom-safe footage from distressing footage
claims.detail: Eight videos with ground truth read off the source, re-judged live. Mean classroom-readiness 0.46 for the four benign clips versus 0.25 for the four distressing ones, a 0.21 gap. Strictly, 5/8 hit the thresholds fixed before the call. Misses: The Animal Sounds Song: classroom 0.41; Nature's Tools! How Birds Use Them: classroom 0.30; Snowball the dancing cockatoo: classroom 0.45.
